# pvecli sdn vnet

Manage SDN vnets.

## add

Create a vnet in a zone. The change stays pending until 'sdn apply'.

```text
pvecli sdn vnet add [VNET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VNET` | Vnet name (8 characters max). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-z`, `--zone VALUE` | Zone this vnet belongs to. |
| `-tg`, `--tag N` | VLAN tag or VXLAN VNI. |
| `-as`, `--alias VALUE` | Free description. |
| `--vlanaware` | Let guests tag their own VLANs. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## remove

Remove a vnet. Refused while guests are still attached to it.

```text
pvecli sdn vnet remove [VNET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VNET` | Vnet to remove. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
